reviews.comment: in class quizzes are pretty easy if you understand thermo. homeworks are completion grade. practice exams help prepare for midterms and finals pretty well. i skipped lecture every day except for quiz days and did fine by just doing the homeworks and practice exams. lectures were incredibly boring, but the class itself is really not that hard.

Dr. Jarrahbashi was a good 402 professor. Since her research is mainly in fluids, she didn't really provide much help for our solids-based project. However, since this is 402, technical feedback wasn't as needed for our group. She grades reports relatively easy. Cares a lot about formatting so note that for presentations/reports.

Merely reads off slides (which are condensed and hard to follow) and doesn't explain concepts well. Common exams are difficult, homework is completion grade, and participation and in-class quizzes are an arbitrary amount of points. If you get her as a professor, make sure you read the textbook and/or find a YouTube playlist to learn off of.

I actually took MEEN 621. I have had many terrible courses and professors before but never one nearly as horrible as this, my only q-drop. DO NOT TAKE THIS! Hw doesn't prepare for her exams, her lectures are horrible, class average on exams is in the 50s, she constantly rushes through the material. She completely changes when watched by evaluator.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were purely read off the slides... which were already mediocre. I had a tough time paying attention in class because she is really bad at explaining things with "um" every 2 secs. So did others, as at any given moment I could glance at someone sleeping through her lecture. The tests were not too bad, as they were just like HW problems.

Her lectures had no applicable content to the exams, couldn't explain how to do example problems unless she had the key with her. No doubt she has mastered Fluid Mechanics, she just could not teach it well. Final was four questions worth 40% of the final grade, two of them were over concepts we had never seen before. Midterms weren't that bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I wish I could give her a 0, one of the worst professors in TAMU, DO NOT TAKE. She has managed to whip up something called student teaching where students walk up to the board and write out answers without giving any concrete feedback. The more irritating part is this could add or subtract 5% off your overall grade (written into the Syllubus)
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS
